# rustinion_group_package_cleanup (Resource)

Manages a group's package cleanup: devices remove packages that are no longer needed (old kernels, never the running or newest one; orphaned dependencies) and clean their package cache after every OS update and at most daily (Windows component cleanup monthly). Never on router/firewall appliances. On by default; destroying this resource turns it back on. Devices can override it with rustinion_device_package_cleanup.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this setting belongs to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Remove unneeded packages and clean the package cache. Default true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
